name: Collagen Peptides
summary: Collagen Peptides carries a Grade D rating — preliminary / theoretical evidence. Strongest recorded design is a randomized controlled trial, drawn from 2 recorded studies, 2 in people. Recorded activity centres on inflammatory signaling modulation, which describes mechanism rather than demonstrated benefit. Noted cautions include known allergy to the source protein.
description: Collagen peptides may support skin and connective tissue maintenance by providing absorbable collagen fragments that influence remodeling; evidence is moderate.
safetyNotes: Usually well tolerated; screen for source-specific allergy.

sources.title: Oral supplementation of specific collagen peptides has beneficial effects on human skin physiology: a double-blind, placebo-controlled study
sources.citation: PubMed PMID 23949208. Minimal citation row added from existing workbook PMID; title/year/journal still require PubMed metadata extraction.
sources.note: evidence citation lookup; PMID source present in Evidence_Register

contraindications: Known allergy to the source protein such as bovine or marine/fish or eggshell-membrane collagen
significant kidney disease or hypercalcemia due to calcium content in some formulations
quinolone or tetracycline antibiotics and bisphosphonates due to reduced absorption when taken simultaneously -- separate dosing by at least two hours.
